name: Eval&GO
description_en:
Evalandgo creates surveys, quizzes, evaluations and forms, with distribution and reporting in the same hosted service. Its English product page describes template or scratch creation, customizable design, publication and response analysis; Live Mode is a separate interactive use with plan conditions.

The free account and the fourteen-day feature trial must be distinguished. A trial can expose advanced design options while still limiting accessible responses. The current English pricing page contains inconsistent annual price displays, so this profile retains the conflict instead of manufacturing a single payable annual price.
description_zh:
Evalandgo 用于创建问卷、测验、评估和表单，并在同一托管服务内分发与报告。英文产品页描述模板或从零创建、设计定制、发布和回答分析；Live Mode 是有套餐条件的现场交互用法。

免费账户与十四天功能试用必须区分。试用可开放高级设计，但可访问回答仍受限。当前英文定价页的年度金额显示不一致，本文保留矛盾，不拼造统一应付年价。

core_features.explanation_en: Create questions and configure design and question flow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 创建题目并配置设计与问题流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Shares links, embeds and invitations, with analysis/export scope depending on plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 支持链接、嵌入和邀请，分析／导出范围取决于套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: PRO+ lists API/webhooks and interactive live quizzes; Free loses Live after trial.
core_features.explanation_zh: PRO+ 列 API／webhook 和现场互动测验，Free 在试用后失去 Live。

en: Evaluate learning with a tested score path
zh: 通过已测试计分路径评估学习
use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.
Research scope.zh: 核对公开文档与商业入口；示例是建议的评估流程。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: Create an account without a card, build a short form, submit known answers and inspect exports and access after the trial. For CRM work, confirm PRO+ API/webhook requirements and who owns the destination connection. Hosted-data and HDS claims need a relevant agreement for a healthcare use case; they are not a blanket approval. No self-hosted package or source-code license was established.
steps.zh: 可免信用卡注册，构建简短表单、提交已知答案，并检查试用后的导出与访问。CRM 任务需确认 PRO+ 的 API／webhook 要求及目标连接负责人。医疗任务需相关协议支持托管数据与 HDS 主张，它们不是通用批准。未建立自托管包或源代码许可。

items.en: A candidate for combined questionnaires, evaluations and live quizzes, this service is different from a respondent panel. Free responses and emails are small even when trial design features are broad. The detailed table limits Live Mode to 200 simultaneous participants and distinguishes trial access from retained Free; confirm the chosen plan and higher-capacity arrangements. Email retries, duplicate detection, export fidelity and annual price conflicts were not resolved by an account test.
items.zh: 需要组合问卷、评估及现场测验时可列入候选，它与受访者样本库不同。即使试用设计功能丰富，免费回答和邮件仍很少。详细表格把 Live Mode 同时参与者限制为 200，并区分试用和长期 Free；应确认套餐及更高容量安排。邮件重试、防重复、导出保真及年度价格冲突未通过账户实测解决。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free lists one user, unlimited questionnaires, ten questions and twenty-five responses per questionnaire. The fourteen-day trial also limits accessible responses to twenty-five and sends to twenty-five emails; later answers are recorded but blocked until upgrading. Monthly prices are PRO €35 and PRO+ €49 excluding tax. The annual block shows PRO €25/month alongside €228/year, which do not reconcile; PRO+ shows €39/month and €468/year. Team displays also conflict and require a quote. PRO+Team is described as annual-only.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 列一人、无限问卷、每份十题及二十五回答。十四天试用也只可访问二十五回答并发送二十五邮件；更多回答会记录但升级前受阻。月付 PRO 为 35 欧元、PRO+ 49 欧元，不含税。年度区同时展示 PRO 每月 25 欧元和每年 228 欧元，无法对应；PRO+ 为每月 39、每年 468 欧元。Team 显示也有冲突，需要询价。PRO+Team 被描述为仅年度方案。

official_check.scope: Public primary-source documentation only. No account execution, purchase, identity claim, price approval, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis with section-aligned Chinese translation. Vendor documentation is not an independent performance test.
Hypothetical workflows and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. No directional alternative relationship has been approved.
Evidence text and SHA-256 metadata retained in .scratch/deep-research/batch-12/eval-go-c890d0a3/; no source text copied into public descriptions.

sections.title_en: Evaluate learning with a tested score path
sections.title_zh: 通过已测试计分路径评估学习
sections.en: For a proposed training evaluation, separate satisfaction questions from knowledge-check questions, define correct answers and review the score shown at completion. Distribute a link or use Live Mode only if the retained tier supports it. Verify a fully correct, partly correct and empty response before interpreting results. An automatically generated quiz does not establish content validity, and a high score does not by itself prove transfer to workplace performance.
sections.zh: 以培训评估为例，分开满意度与知识检查题，定义正确答案并审核完成页分数。通过链接分发，或仅在长期档位支持时使用 Live Mode。解读前验证全对、部分正确与空答。自动生成测验不证明内容有效，高分本身也不证明能迁移到工作表现。
